_about: Defaults for simitall_power_sweep(). Every value can be overridden by the function arguments; the ones used are written to power_sweep.json.

reps.note: values of design.reps to lay out; for designs with entries and checks this is the number of blocks

alpha.note: significance level of each model term's test (ANOVA F test from Bioana)

target_power.note: power used to report the smallest adequate reps

n_genes.note: genes per count simulation during the sweep (power is computed for the primary outcome only)

max_minutes.note: stop before running when one simulated fit, times n_sim and the reps values (scaled by size), is estimated to take longer than this
